blocks.prompt: 5. The A.M. of two positive integral numbers exceeds their (positive) G.M. by 2 and their sum is 20, find the numbers.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh word problem (ibarati sawal) hai: har jumle ko equation mein badalna hai.
Sum se A.M. milega; "A.M., G.M. se 2 zyada hai" se G.M. milega, aur G.M. se product.
Plan: jab do numbers ka sum aur product maloom ho, to woh \(t^{2} - (\text{sum})t + (\text{product}) = 0\) ke roots hote hain.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: do positive whole numbers \(a, b\); \(a + b = 20\) aur \(A - G = 2\).
Humein find karna hai: \(a\) aur \(b\).
Tareeqa: \(A = \frac{a+b}{2}\) aur positive G.M. \(G = \sqrt{ab}\). In se sum aur product nikal kar quadratic equation (do darje ki muadla) banayenge.

A.M. nikalein
\[A = \dfrac{a + b}{2} = \dfrac{20}{2} = 10\]
Kyun: A.M. dono numbers ke sum ka aadha hota hai, aur sum humein diya hua hai.

G.M. aur product nikalein
\[G = A - 2 = 8\]
\[\sqrt{ab} = 8 \Rightarrow ab = 64\]
Kyun: "A.M. exceeds G.M. by 2" ka matlab \(A - G = 2\), is liye \(G = 10 - 2 = 8\). Square root hatane ke liye dono taraf square kiya: \(ab = 64\).
Dhyan dein: \(G = A + 2\) mat likhiye; A.M. bara hai, G.M. chhota.

Quadratic banayein
\[t^{2} - 20t + 64 = 0\]
Kyun: Agar do numbers ka sum \(s\) aur product \(p\) ho to woh \(t^{2} - st + p = 0\) ke roots hote hain, kyunke \((t - a)(t - b) = t^{2} - (a + b)t + ab\). Yeh trick A.M./G.M. ke "numbers find karo" wale har sawal mein kaam aati hai.

Quadratic hal karein
\[t^{2} - 4t - 16t + 64 = 0\]
\[(t - 4)(t - 16) = 0\]
\[t = 4 \text{ ya } t = 16\]
Kyun: Aise do numbers chahiye jin ka product 64 aur sum \(-20\) ho: \(-4\) aur \(-16\). Middle term ko tod kar pairs mein factorise kiya: \(t(t - 4) - 16(t - 4)\).

Tasdeeq
\[4 + 16 = 20,\ \ \sqrt{4 \times 16} = 8\]
\[A - G = 10 - 8 = 2\]
Kyun: Sum 20 hai, G.M. 8 hai, aur A.M. G.M. se waqai 2 zyada hai. Dono numbers positive integers bhi hain, jaisa sawal ne kaha tha.
